cases.prompt: Keep pushing fixes to PR #17 until every check passes.
Our landing page only gets 62 on the mobile performance audit, so keep making changes and putting them live until it holds above 90.
Run the vulnerability checker against staging, wait for its report, fix whatever it flags, and run it again until it comes back clean.
I have three approved PRs and every merge to main ships straight to production, so merge them one at a time and confirm the site is serving each new build before starting the next.
Copilot posts a fresh batch of comments on PR #31 after every push, so work through them round after round until it stops finding things and the build passes.
Look at the Copilot comments on PR #31 and tell me which ones are false positives.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: a single triage pass over review comments on one PR belongs to pr-feedback.

cases.prompt: Split this feature into checkout, search and admin lanes, hand each lane to its own subagent, and gate their merges while I'm away this afternoon.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: running several agents across lanes on one build belongs to agent-orchestration.

cases.prompt: The lint step on PR #12 fails on an unused import in utils.ts; remove it.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: a known single-shot fix belongs to code-authoring, not an iterative loop.
